containers.name: gc
command: while sleep 86400; do registry garbage-collect /etc/distribution/config.yml; done

containers.name: forward
args:
IP="__TAILNET_IP__"
to=TCP:pyo.pyo-system.svc.cluster.local:8000
socat TCP-LISTEN:8000,bind=127.0.0.1,fork,reuseaddr $to &
socat TCP-LISTEN:5005,bind=127.0.0.1,fork,reuseaddr TCP:pyo-registry.pyo-system.svc.cluster.local:5000 &
if [ -n "$IP" ]; then
  socat TCP-LISTEN:8000,bind="$IP",fork,reuseaddr $to &
  socat TCP-LISTEN:5005,bind="$IP",fork,reuseaddr TCP:pyo-registry-door.pyo-system.svc.cluster.local:5006 &
fi
wait

data.buildkitd.toml:
[registry."127.0.0.1:5005"]
  http = true
  insecure = true
[worker.oci]
  gc = true
  gckeepstorage = "20GB"

data.garage.toml:
metadata_dir = "/var/lib/garage/meta"
data_dir = "/var/lib/garage/data"
db_engine = "lmdb"
replication_factor = 1
compression_level = "none"
block_ram_buffer_max = "64MiB"
rpc_bind_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"
rpc_public_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"

[s3_api]
s3_region = "garage"
api_bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:3900"

[admin]
api_bind_addr = "0.0.0.0:3903"
metrics_require_token = true
